item.title: EDITORIAL: Refine, pass bill to overhaul HI-5
item.description: The fever chart says it all: A trace follows a bumpy but decidedly downward trend line, marking a steep decline in how much Hawaii delivered on its recycling pledge.

item.title: Happy Camper for Friday, February 27, 2026
item.description: It’s a big weekend on Saturday with the Kauai Healthy Living Fair (free bicycle and skateboarding helmets with proper fitting!) at the Samuel Mahelona Memorial Hospital campus, the big Olelo Hawaii celebration at the Kukui Grove, and what? A jamboree style outing at the Bryan J. Baptiste Sports Complex for the Kauai Interscholastic Federation Girls Flag Football?

item.title: Kapaa, Waimea lead Kauai Interscholastic Federation hoops All-Stars
item.description: LIHUE — The Kauai Interscholastic Federation released the KIF All-Stars for the boys and girls basketball programs on Thursday.

item.title: Fighting coconut rhinoceros beetles one grove at a time
item.description: As the coconut rhinoceros beetle wreaks havoc on Oahu’s coconut trees, one group is fighting back with a simple strategy: planting.

item.title: Rising child care costs strain families despite wage gains
item.description: With Hawaii’s cost of living ranking among the highest in the nation, state leaders are accelerating public preschool and child care subsidy expansions aimed at helping working families afford early education.

item.title: Pau Hana Market helps Red Raiders’ Future Farmers of America
item.description: LIHUE — The Monday Pau Hana Market at Kukui Grove proved fruitful for Kauai High School teacher Christina Martiney and her agricultural students.

item.title: Painting Paradise opens in Puhi
item.description: PUHI — When the Waimea building housing artist Marionette Taboniar’s gallery was sold, she and other building tenants lost their space.

item.title: Tokuda introduces ‘Tariff Free Farming Act’
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — U.S. Rep Jill Tokuda (HI-02) has introduced the “Tariff Free Farming Act” to lower costs for farmers by eliminating President Trump’s tariffs on essential agricultural imported supplies, according to a Thursday press release.

item.title: Bill aims to elevate status of Hawaii’s coconut trees
item.description: A bill that would recognize the coconut tree as a food and water source and cultural treasure is moving forward in the state Legislature.
